title: Skit: you're chopped, Jake's voiceover
source: The founder's script (2026-10-16), told story-time style by Jake. Her texts are on-screen bubbles only (no voice). Hints are the first plan; the picture follows the measured clips.

lines.text: Hey guys. I finally had the courage to get a cute girl's number. At the grocery store.
I spent two hours deciding what to text her. And I sent… "hey."
lines.spoken: I spent two hours deciding what to text her. And I sent... hey.

lines.text: Two more hours. "Hey, how are you?"
lines.spoken: Two more hours. Hey, how are you?

lines.text: So I go, "hey, you said I was handsome. Why are you ghosting me?"
lines.spoken: So I go, hey, you said I was handsome. Why are you ghosting me?

lines.text: Two days later, she finally replies.
So I got mad. Looked it up. Found this app called Curate.
It found all my clothes in my camera roll.
Then I asked Zee for a fit for drinks.
